title: Research: certify all S4 two-premium two-register tariffs
body:
## Summary

Certify exact additivity for every diagonal `S4` target pair on two arbitrary dirty registers when adjacent labels cost `(2,1,2)`.

```text
300 unordered pairs
  253 have matching inherited cut bounds
   47 need the new complete weighted meet
576 ordered pairs: minimum = d(a) + d(b)
```

The package is `research/s4-two-premium-registers/`. C++ left-multiplication and separately written Python right-multiplication engines regenerate the same 971,369 formal states and all 47 complete query receipts. Neither imports predecessor search code. Both implementations were prepared in this session; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.

This follows Ross Richardson's #1989 weighted-price handoff, complementary to #2577's one-premium theorem and #2544's S3 tariff. The cut method retains credit to Adam Gall #1941 and Ross Richardson #1966; #1974 is a related exact-census precedent. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2570).

## Evidence

- Before, the combined cuts gave only 14 against direct bill 16 for two `(14)` targets, and 16 against bill 18 for two reversals. After, both complete formal engines certify minima 16 and 18 and settle every other pair.
- Registered replay passes under CPython 3.12.15/GCC 14.2.0. It includes 576 full dirty endpoints/inverses, 3,456 omitted-call controls, explicit cut ranks and seven behavioral test groups.
- State-capacity exhaustion, forced hash collisions, wrong order, dirty leaks, receipt/source corruption and optimized read-only Git-free replay are exercised.
- All 65 repository `test_research_*.py` tests pass. The full C++ census passes AddressSanitizer/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer and strict warnings. Python development-mode compilation passes with warnings treated as errors.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/s4-two-premium-registers
```

Base and final canonical main are `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Source pins, scope change, overlap freshness and structured next questions are in `TASK.json` and `SOURCES.json`. Final overlap covered 776 open PRs and 1,238 Discussion records with complete pagination; arbitrary diffs and comprehensive closed-PR coverage remain outside the helper.

Limits: fixed `(2,1,2)` prices and exactly two registers for the finite exclusion. Extra dirty roles, other tariff ratios, native/compiler/hosting admission, precision/tape and recursive moments remain open. No new kappa, selected-supplier adoption, full selected cold replay or multiplication theorem is claimed.

## Merge danger

Door: reversible. Blast radius: research-only.

Adds one opt-in package. No selected frontier, frozen evidence, predecessor package or existing verifier changes. Hosted CI is separate from the local evidence above.
